pieces.title: Lalit Sakhī

fields.notes: A brāhmaṇa, once a notorious dacoit, who became a Vaiṣṇava by Narottama Ṭhākura's grace (Prema-vilāsa 19). Taken out of the record «Lalitāsakhī Dāsī» #837 (07-11-2026).

A disciple of Muralīdhara, who was related to Nārāyaṇa Bhaṭṭa; wrote the Kahānī-rahasī in Saṁvat 1835 and the Kuṁvarī-keli in Saṁvat 1836. Taken out of the record «Lalitāsakhī Dāsī» #837 (07-11-2026).
A disciple of Rasikānanda Prabhu (Rasika-maṅgala, Paścima 14.131). Taken out of the record «Lalitāsakhī Dāsī» #837 (07-11-2026).
